reviews.body: Reviewed. The unnamed side now comes from `HEADLESS_VIEWPORT`, the same size a lease without `emulate` opens with, so the two paths cannot drift again. The width-only and height-only cases fail on main. One optional follow-up: build the description string from `HEADLESS_VIEWPORT` instead of the literal "1440 by 900", so that text cannot drift either. Thank you.

comments.body: Thanks for your first pull request to Reticle! A maintainer aims to review within two days. Before then, `pnpm verify` locally catches most of what CI will, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the rest. If CI does not start, a maintainer needs to approve it for first-time contributors; that is normal.

Done in a small commit on top: the `emulate` argument description now builds "(W by H)" from `HEADLESS_VIEWPORT`, with a test that checks the text against the constant.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
